payload.title: The freeze is final only where a non-required workflow runs: pinGenesis re-pins a post-freeze findings.jsonl without condition, and the always-run integrity spec holds the event logs to the merge-base but never genesis.json
evidence: tests/invariants/finding-registry-integrity.spec.ts:622-659 (T7 compares findings/** with the merge-base and never genesis.json)
tools/gates/finding-registry-events.ts:389-393 (GENESIS_REMEDY offers `npm run findings:genesis` for any pin mismatch)
tools/gates/finding-registry-events.ts:437-465 (pinGenesis re-pins the blob on disk and never reads the base's pin)
tools/gates/finding-registry-events.ts:587-623 (appendOnlyDefects, the one place genesis.json is held to the base)
.github/workflows/closes-footer-check.yml:80-87 (the only caller of verify --base; the check is not in .github/manifests/main-required-status-checks.json)
payload.rule_violated: CLAUDE.md architectural-solution hierarchy tiers 1 to 3, MF-DESIGN section 6 steps 3 and 4: the freeze is final by construction or by a gate every PR runs; a rule enforced only by a check no merge requires is not enforced
payload.notes: A branch that appended a row to findings.jsonl after the freeze takes the remedy the pin-failure message names (`npm run findings:genesis`). The review's probe (a throwaway repo with the frozen store): genesis exits 0, `verify` exits 0, so the always-run T6 and T7 pass, and only `verify --base=main` in the Closes Footer Check exits 1 (genesis.json: changed since main, the freeze is final). That workflow is not a required context, so the frozen segment can be rewritten and merged. Close condition: pinGenesis refuses when merge-base(HEAD, origin/main) already carries a genesis.json that differs from the pin it would write, and GENESIS_REMEDY stops offering the re-pin then. T7 (or a new always-run invariant) holds genesis.json byte-equal to the base, as appendOnlyDefects does. A test where a branch based on a pinned main appends a findings.jsonl row, runs the re-pin, and fails the invariant spec. The pre-freeze landing step, where the base carries no pin, keeps working.
